project_type: Django 5.1 + DRF backend, React 18 + Vite + TypeScript frontend, monorepo
build_system: Python venv at d:\scout system\.venv, Node/Vite at d:\scout system\frontend. All commands run from d:\scout system root.
test_framework: pytest with django-pytest, config in pytest.ini at root. DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE=config.settings.dev. pythonpath=backend.
verification_instructions: 1) Run .venv\Scripts\pytest.exe from d:\scout system root. 2) Run .venv\Scripts\ruff.exe check backend. 3) Run .venv\Scripts\python.exe backend\manage.py migrate. 4) Check .venv\Scripts\python.exe backend\manage.py check.
snapshot_or_generated_files: migrations are generated by makemigrations and must be committed. Run .venv\Scripts\python.exe backend\manage.py makemigrations users structure members
environment_constraints: Windows OS. Use powershell. All venv commands use .venv\Scripts\. weasyprint not available on Windows — never import it in this phase. Axes is disabled in tests (AXES_ENABLED=False when pytest in sys.modules).
contribution_requirements: All models must inherit BaseUUIDModel. Vital models must also inherit SoftDeleteModel + TimeStampedModel. AUTH_USER_MODEL must be set to 'users.User' before first migration. AuditMixin required on all mutating ViewSets. BaseScopedPermission required on all ViewSets.
key_patterns: BaseUUIDModel/TimeStampedModel/SoftDeleteModel/AuditLog are in backend/apps/common/models.py. SoftDeleteManager provides .alive() queryset. AuditLog.objects.create() with action=AuditAction.X. Tests use @pytest.mark.django_db. API tests use APIClient from rest_framework.test. Test fixtures use pytest fixtures not TestCase. Apps apps.py pattern: name='apps.X', verbose_name='Arabic name'.
directory_structure: d:\scout system\backend\apps\common\ — existing Phase 0 app. d:\scout system\backend\config\settings\ — base.py + dev.py. d:\scout system\backend\apps\ — new apps go here. d:\scout system\.venv\ — Python venv. pytest.ini at root.
